composite_doctrine.ruling: RH 2026-07-25: chord ≠ point. The SKOS chord renders the FULL hierarchy (home families, sector tier, in-scope-external scheme members like PRODML under ENERGY); the point layer stays sparse — one qdrant point per admission anchor, membership ENUMERATED.
